title: Padded batches and valid targets
description: Terms for excluding batch storage without changing causal predictions or their token-weighted loss.

terms.definition: Extra batch storage used to align unequal rows. The marker -1 has no vocabulary ID or embedding row and supplies neither an attended key nor a training target.
The number of immediate next-token pairs in an example. A selected range with three source tokens supplies two predictions; its final source token appears as a target.
A real source token immediately following an example's input token. EOS can be a valid target; padding storage cannot.
The attention rule allowing a real query to use only real keys in its own example at positions no later than the query. Inactive queries skip normalization.
The explicit selection of supervised targets. This chapter includes every real target and excludes padding before target lookup and loss arithmetic.
Raw loss sums divided once by the total number of valid targets. When combining document means, weight each by its valid-target count first.
